headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Rust Integration
summary: By integrating Rust support, ClearInstall can offer a more comprehensive install-time risk analysis. Additionally, incorporating real-time dependency tracking and enhancing the UI for better user experience will further solidify its position as a leading local-first lockfile auditor.
actions: Integrate Rust package handling to cover rust-anything and related projects, ensuring all dependencies are checked against potential risks before installation.
Implement real-time dependency tracking to alert users of any changes or updates in their project dependencies that could introduce new risks during the install
